facts.fact: pytest requires Python 3.10 or newer (or PyPy3).
In setup.cfg, pytest configuration must live in a [tool:pytest] section; plain [pytest] sections in setup.cfg are no longer supported (removed in 4.0).
facts.source_quote: ``[pytest]`` sections in ``setup.cfg`` files should now be named ``[tool:pytest]``

facts.fact: pytest.toml (new in 9.0) takes precedence over all other configuration files, including pytest.ini.
facts.source_quote: ``pytest.toml`` files take precedence over other files, even when empty.

facts.fact: pytest.yield_fixture is a deprecated alias for pytest.fixture (deprecated since 6.2, to be removed in pytest 10); plain @pytest.fixture should be used for yield fixtures.
facts.source_quote: ``pytest.yield_fixture`` is a deprecated alias for :func:`pytest.fixture` and will be removed in pytest 10.

facts.fact: The tmp_path/tmp_path_factory fixtures (pathlib.Path) are preferred; tmpdir/tmpdir_factory are legacy py.path-based fixtures.
facts.source_quote: These days, it is preferred to use ``tmp_path`` and ``tmp_path_factory``.
